scope: Selection only. No candidate repository was cloned, no environment or checkpoint was installed or downloaded, and Experiment 1 was not run.

selection_criteria.A: Public source, documented checkpoint path, environment, and runnable author workflow.
selection_criteria.B: A generated geometry artifact G can be materialized and frozen.
selection_criteria.C: Observed geometry O and generated geometry G remain independently identifiable at the experimental boundary; G=F(O) is allowed.
selection_criteria.D: An external, fixed multi-region partition can be applied to the frozen geometry.
selection_criteria.F: Frozen O/G can be reused for baseline, plausible-wrong, and oracle-A variants without regenerating them.
selection_criteria.G: Scientific relevance and structural complexity are sufficient for the structural-association experiment.

candidates.name: 3D-Fixer
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 for repository code; third-party notices apply

source_pipeline.O: MoGe-derived visible scene/instance depth projected to scene.ply and instance_est_depth_<id>.ply before pipeline.run.
source_pipeline.G: In-place conditioned Gaussian/mesh output from pipeline.run, exported as objects/<id>.glb.
source_pipeline.freeze_point: Persist O PLYs and the exported GLB after a fixed seed, prior to any external partition or association operation.
source_pipeline.fused_identity: The completion pipeline consumes the instance geometry condition internally; its generated mesh is materialized only at the output boundary.
source_pipeline.region_access: PLY and GLB are externally readable; the source itself makes per-instance masks and PLYs.

candidates.official_evaluation: ARSG-110K test assets with object/scene metrics scripts including IoU, Chamfer, precision, recall, and F1.
candidates.environment: Linux; Python >=3.8; CUDA 11.8 or 12.8; setup.sh builds TRELLIS-derived CUDA components.
candidates.vrm_note: Official prerequisite is an NVIDIA GPU with at least 24GB; only RTX 4090 and L20 are stated as verified.
candidates.risk: The published 24GB minimum exceeds LabServer63's 12GB GPU; do not attempt an unsupported installation in this selection batch.

candidates.name: World Tracing
candidates.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; non-commercial research use, no derivatives may be redistributed

source_pipeline.O: An RGB/RGBA image, not an independently supplied observed geometry artifact.
source_pipeline.G: A predicted multilayer XYZ tensor logged as a .rrd visualization artifact; optional TRELLIS.2 stages 2/3 convert XYZ-derived voxels to GLB.
source_pipeline.freeze_point: The per-layer xyz_pred is produced after diffusion, but the author quickstart exposes a .rrd rather than a canonical O/G pair.
source_pipeline.fused_identity: Visible and occluded geometry are produced together as one layered prediction from image pixels.
source_pipeline.region_access: XYZ is available in the inference result and can be rendered/exported, but the default release artifact is .rrd and no official GT geometry benchmark workflow is provided.

candidates.official_evaluation: Packaged demo images and checkpoints; no author GT completion benchmark/evaluator found in the inference-only release.
candidates.environment: Python >=3.10, Linux, CUDA 12; optional GLB path adds TRELLIS.2.
candidates.vrm_note: Tested on 80GB A100/H100; authors state smaller GPUs can use fewer steps or resolution, without a 12GB validation.
candidates.risk: Treating a derived layer-0 depth map as O would introduce a new, non-author experimental boundary, so this candidate is not a valid substitute for the required O/G causal test.

candidates.name: PGNet (Completion-by-Correction)

source_pipeline.G: ShapeNetViPC-Gen/trellis/<sampling>/num_points_<N>/<category>/<object>/<view>.pt prior point cloud, pre-generated from a rendered view with TRELLIS.
source_pipeline.freeze_point: Before PGNet forward: hash and freeze the .dat O and .pt G. The official evaluator loads them independently and calls model(gen_pc, partial_pc).
source_pipeline.fused_identity: PGNet's correction stage fuses distinct generative-prior and partial-observation features; the final fine point cloud is separate from frozen inputs.
source_pipeline.region_access: Both boundary artifacts are coordinate point clouds, so a deterministic external multi-region partition can operate without altering PGNet.

candidates.official_evaluation: ShapeNetViPC test list with partial, generated-prior, GT, and view data; inference.py reports Chamfer-L2, F-score at 0.001, and EMD.
candidates.environment: Ubuntu 24.04; Python 3.10; PyTorch 2.4.0 with CUDA 12.1; PointNet++, Vox2Seq, Chamfer, and EMD CUDA extensions.
candidates.checkpoint_status: A path for a trained .pth is required by the official evaluator, but no author-controlled PGNet trained-checkpoint download was found in the README, repository, releases, or author-linked Hugging Face material inspected on 2026-09-11.
candidates.vrm_note: Officially tested on RTX 4090 only; no memory minimum or 12GB validation is claimed.
candidates.risk: No checkpoint must be substituted with self-training, a third-party weight, or a modified model. Its absence rejects this primary before environment construction.

candidates.name: GenPC

source_pipeline.G: Generator-derived geometry and the fused result under workspace/<id>/; configuration requests saving intermediate files and evaluation reads workspace/<id>/<id>_fused.ply.
source_pipeline.freeze_point: A valid future gate would have to inventory and hash the first generator-only point/mesh artifact before ScaleAdapter fusion; the current README does not name that artifact contract.
source_pipeline.fused_identity: Depth prompting bridges O to image generation and an image-to-3D prior; scale/pose registration then geometrically fuses the prior back to O.
source_pipeline.region_access: The fused PLY is externally accessible; generator-only output naming and a stable partition boundary require source inspection after a pristine checkout.

candidates.official_evaluation: Repository evaluates fused PLY against data/GT/<id>.ply with CD and EMD, but the README does not package a canonical public test split or sample bundle.
candidates.environment: Python 3.10, CUDA >=12, PyTorch 2.6/cu126, compiled Chamfer/EMD, Kaolin, PyTorch3D, Nunchaku, TRELLIS.2.
candidates.vrm_note: No author VRAM minimum; README warns of a memory leak between its two stages.
candidates.risk: The direct prior/fusion design is relevant, but a multi-upstream CUDA stack, undocumented 12GB requirement, no packaged canonical sample split, and unstated generator-only freeze contract keep it below PGNet.

candidates.name: Point-based Instance Completion with Scene Constraints
candidates.checkpoints: Author Box links for object-pretrained and ScanWCF scene-completion checkpoints.

source_pipeline.O: Instance-segmented partial scan plus sparse scene/free/occluded-space constraint point clouds.
source_pipeline.G: A direct predicted completion/reconstructed mesh after cross-attention with scene constraints.
source_pipeline.freeze_point: Final completions/reconstructions can be saved and visualized, but the release does not expose an independently generated prior G before its fusion network.
source_pipeline.fused_identity: Partial observation and scene constraints are fused through cross-attention before direct completion.
source_pipeline.region_access: Completion and reconstruction paths support external mesh/point processing.

candidates.official_evaluation: ScanWCF supports CD, IoU, LFD, PCR, and scene-completion evaluation, but its dataset requires a terms-of-use request and omits licensed ShapeNet meshes.
candidates.environment: Conda environment plus NKSR torch-2.0.0+cu118 wheel and PointNet++ operators.
candidates.risk: It is a strong scene-completion baseline but not a clean pre-fusion generated-G reference, and data access is not immediately public.

decision.rationale: PGNet alone exposes a pre-generated point-cloud G and a partial geometric O as distinct on-disk inputs to the official evaluator, with official GT metrics. This matches the causal boundary before convenience. The missing author checkpoint and unverified 12GB runtime are explicit pre-install hard gates, not waived assumptions.

primary_next_gate.name: PGNet checkpoint-and-single-sample functional-reproduction gate
primary_next_gate.revision_strategy: If and only if checkpoint availability passes, create a new immutable upstream checkout at cd2b368e960d6e733259c0c9f78c4ea7b91f9480 under a new PGNet-specific reference directory; retain it unmodified and record recursive/submodule state.
primary_next_gate.checkpoint_gate: Locate an author-controlled downloadable PGNet category checkpoint matching the exact source/configuration; record URL, revision or file hash, size, and license. Do not train, use a third-party checkpoint, or infer a checkpoint from reported numbers.
primary_next_gate.environment_gate: After checkpoint success only, construct a fresh isolated Python 3.10/PyTorch 2.4 CUDA 12.1 environment, compile the four official extensions, and prove imports and model load on the RTX 3080 Ti before any inference.
primary_next_gate.official_sample_gate: Use one fixed official ShapeNetViPC test-list entry in a stated category, preserving partial .dat, generated-prior .pt, GT .dat, view data, config, seed, coordinate normalization, and all hashes.
primary_next_gate.expected_boundary: Freeze O=.dat and G=.pt before model(gen_pc, partial_pc); save the unmodified fine output outside the pristine upstream checkout. No region partition or association operation occurs at this gate.
primary_next_gate.evaluation_gate: Run the author evaluator's Chamfer-L2, F-score threshold 0.001, and EMD on the same frozen official sample only after a successful forward pass.
primary_next_gate.success_condition: Exact source revision, author checkpoint provenance, extension imports, model load, one official sample forward pass without OOM, frozen O/G hashes, a baseline output, and official metrics all exist.
stop_conditions: No author-controlled trained PGNet checkpoint is available or its provenance cannot be verified.
Official ShapeNetViPC data/prior file layout cannot supply one complete O/G/GT sample.
Exact environment or extension build fails, model load is incompatible, or the RTX 3080 Ti exhausts memory on the documented single-sample path.
The source cannot preserve an independent G artifact and O artifact at the stated boundary.
primary_next_gate.on_stop: Classify PGNet as rejected at its named gate, preserve all evidence, do not install the fallback in the same batch, and do not run Experiment 1.
